title: Cities: Skylines | Power, Politics, & Planning: Episode 3: Gentrification
description:
This is a video about gentrification. I tried to cover as much as possible and there's still huge amounts of stuff I missed, so don't worry, there will be more about this in the future. 

The intro music is Tragic Overture, Op. 81, by Johannes Brahms. It is the version by the Musopen Symphony, and is in the public domain. You can find the recording here: 
https://musopen.org/music/2120-tragic-overture-op-81/

Support me on the Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/donoteat

Check out my Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198000417378/myworkshopfiles/?appid=255710

Or buy me a coffee if you don't want to do a monthly commitment! https://www.buymeacoffee.com/iyzOSEkfw

Big thanks to King Leno who did a whole bunch of the apartment buildings I put up in this episode. They're realistic enough that when I saw them on the workshop I was terrified they were going to tear down my house and put one up. He's got a workshop and a patreon, respectively:

https://steamcommunity.com/id/kingleno/myworkshopfiles/
https://www.patreon.com/kingleno

and also vladalexsh who did the taller buildings I plopped, he's got a paypal donation link in all his assets, so please donate since this guy apparently needs some shoes?

https://steamcommunity.com/id/vladalexsh/myworkshopfiles/?appid=255710

background buildings by Feinbild and Khrysler, WS links, respectively:

https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197978975775/myworkshopfiles/?appid=255710

modding is largely unpaid labor so throw them some bux if you can -- oh jeez, wait until I do that video
